description: Creates a new Stripe Price for a product, defining its charges (one-time or recurring) and billing scheme; requires either an existing `product` ID or `product_data`.

inputSchema.description: Request to create a Stripe Price, defining its currency, amount, and billing structure (one-time or recurring).

active.description: Whether the price can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true.
active.title: Active

billing_scheme.description: Describes how to compute the price per period. Either 'per_unit' (default, for fixed price per unit) or 'tiered' (for volume-based or graduated tiers).
billing_scheme.title: Billing Scheme

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Must be a supported currency.
currency.title: Currency

additionalProperties.description: Defines pricing details for a specific currency, used in `currency_options`.

anyOf.description: Configuration for a price where the unit amount is set by the customer at checkout.

enabled.description: Pass `true` to enable `custom_unit_amount`, allowing the customer to set the price.
enabled.title: Enabled

maximum.description: The maximum unit amount (in the smallest currency unit) the customer can specify.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: The minimum unit amount (in the smallest currency unit) the customer can specify.
minimum.title: Minimum

preset.description: The starting unit amount (in the smallest currency unit) that can be updated by the customer. This is the initial value presented.
preset.title: Preset

anyOf.title: CustomUnitAmount

custom_unit_amount.description: Configuration for a customer-defined unit amount for this currency.

tax_behavior.description: Specifies whether the price already includes tax ('inclusive'), tax is added on top ('exclusive'), or tax behavior is not specified ('unspecified').
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

items.description: Defines pricing tiers for a specific currency within `currency_options`.

flat_amount.description: The flat billing amount for this tier in the currency (smallest unit).
flat_amount.title: Flat Amount

flat_amount_decimal.description: Decimal string representation of `flat_amount` for this tier in the currency.
flat_amount_decimal.title: Flat Amount Decimal

unit_amount.description: The per-unit billing amount for this tier in the currency (smallest unit).
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Decimal string representation of `unit_amount` for this tier in the currency.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

up_to.description: Specifies the upper bound of this tier for the specific currency. Use 'inf' for the last tier.
up_to.title: Up To

items.title: CurrencyOptionTier

tiers.description: A list of pricing tiers for this currency, if `billing_scheme` is 'tiered'.
tiers.title: Tiers

unit_amount.description: The unit amount in the smallest currency unit for this currency. Required if not using `tiers` or `custom_unit_amount`.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Decimal string representation of `unit_amount` for this currency. Provides higher precision.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

additionalProperties.title: CurrencyOption

currency_options.description: Prices defined in each supported currency. Useful for multi-currency pricing. The primary `currency`'s pricing can also be defined here.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

custom_unit_amount.description: Configuration for a price where the unit amount is set by the customer at checkout.

enabled.description: Pass `true` to enable `custom_unit_amount`, allowing the customer to set the price.
enabled.title: Enabled

maximum.description: The maximum unit amount (in the smallest currency unit) the customer can specify.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: The minimum unit amount (in the smallest currency unit) the customer can specify.
minimum.title: Minimum

preset.description: The starting unit amount (in the smallest currency unit) that can be updated by the customer. This is the initial value presented.
preset.title: Preset

custom_unit_amount.title: CustomUnitAmount

lookup_key.description: A unique, user-defined key to retrieve this price. Case-sensitive.
lookup_key.title: Lookup Key

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs to store additional information about the price.
metadata.title: Metadata

nickname.description: A brief, internal-facing description of the price. Useful for distinguishing prices in listings.
nickname.title: Nickname

product.description: The ID of the product this price is for. Required if `product_data` is not provided.
product.title: Product

product_data.description: Fields for creating a new product if a `product` ID is not provided with the price.

active.description: Whether the product is currently available for purchase. Defaults to true.
active.title: Active

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs to store additional information about the product.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: The product’s name, meant to be displayable to the customer.
name.title: Name

statement_descriptor.description: An arbitrary string to be displayed on the customer's credit card statement. This field is not available for all payment methods.
statement_descriptor.title: Statement Descriptor

tax_code.description: A tax code ID that identifies the taxability of this product. Recommended for products that are subject to tax.
tax_code.title: Tax Code

unit_label.description: A label that represents units of this product. For example, 'user' or 'GB'.
unit_label.title: Unit Label

product_data.title: ProductData

recurring.description: Specifies recurring components of a price, such as billing interval and usage type.

aggregate_usage.description: For `usage_type=metered`, specifies how usage records are aggregated. Options include 'sum', 'last_during_period', 'last_ever', or 'max'. Defaults to 'sum'. This field is ignored if `usage_type` is 'licensed'.
aggregate_usage.title: Aggregate Usage

interval.description: Specifies the billing frequency. Must be one of 'day', 'week', 'month', or 'year'.
interval.title: Interval

interval_count.description: The number of intervals between subscription billings. For example, `interval=month` and `interval_count=3` bills every 3 months. Defaults to 1.
interval_count.title: Interval Count

meter.description: The ID of the meter from which to read usage when `usage_type=metered`. Required if `usage_type='metered'` and not using `product.meter`.
meter.title: Meter

usage_type.description: Configures how usage is calculated. Set to 'metered' to bill based on usage, or 'licensed' for a fixed quantity. Defaults to 'licensed'.
usage_type.title: Usage Type

recurring.title: Recurring

tax_behavior.description: Specifies how tax is applied to the price. Options are 'inclusive' (tax is included), 'exclusive' (tax is added), or 'unspecified'.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

tiers.description: A list of pricing tiers. Required if `billing_scheme` is 'tiered'.

items.description: Represents a pricing tier for tiered billing (`billing_scheme = 'tiered'`).

flat_amount.description: The flat billing amount for an entire tier (in the smallest currency unit), if any. Cannot be used with `unit_amount`.
flat_amount.title: Flat Amount

flat_amount_decimal.description: Same as `flat_amount`, but accepts a decimal string with up to 12 decimal places. Suitable for higher precision.
flat_amount_decimal.title: Flat Amount Decimal

unit_amount.description: The per-unit billing amount in the smallest currency unit for this tier. Cannot be used with `flat_amount`.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Same as `unit_amount`, but accepts a decimal string with up to 12 decimal places. Suitable for higher precision.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

up_to.description: Specifies the upper bound of this tier. Can be an integer or 'inf' for the last tier (fallback tier).
up_to.title: Up To

items.title: Tier

tiers.title: Tiers

tiers_mode.description: Defines how the quantity is applied to the tiers. Either 'graduated' (price is sum of costs from applicable tiers) or 'volume' (price is determined by the tier corresponding to the total quantity). Required if `billing_scheme` is 'tiered'.
tiers_mode.title: Tiers Mode

transfer_lookup_key.description: If `true`, allows this price to overwrite an existing price with the same `lookup_key`. Defaults to `false`.
transfer_lookup_key.title: Transfer Lookup Key

transform_quantity.description: Contains information about how the quantity should be transformed before calculating the price.

divide_by.description: Divide the reported usage quantity by this number.
divide_by.title: Divide By

round.description: After division, specifies how the result should be rounded. Must be one of 'up' or 'down'.
round.title: Round

transform_quantity.title: TransformQuantity

unit_amount.description: The base charge amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Required if not using `tiers`, `custom_unit_amount`, or `currency_options` with a unit amount for the primary currency.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Same as `unit_amount`, but accepts a decimal string with up to 12 decimal places for higher precision. Required if not using `tiers`, `custom_unit_amount`, or `currency_options` with a unit amount for the primary currency and `unit_amount` is not provided.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal
